title: He lands in his own outline and the shop lights up
beat: The hanging sign is EMPTY - just an outline where the pickle should be. He tumbles in from above, lands exactly in it, and the shop lights up behind.

invariants.title: Sign starts empty
invariants.rule: The shot opens on the sign with the pickle ABSENT and only his outline drawn on the board.
invariants.why: It is the whole gag: the sign is waiting for him.

invariants.title: Landing is pixel exact
invariants.rule: He lands on exactly the rectangle he was removed from, so the merge is a cross-fade onto the untouched photograph.
invariants.why: Both the hole and the landing are generated from one measured rect, so they cannot drift apart. An approximate landing reads as a cut.

invariants.title: Mirrored to this side
invariants.rule: The flying figure is mirrored and colour-drifted to the sign's turquoise side.
invariants.why: 1-2.jpg and 2-1.jpg show OPPOSITE sides of the sign - different facing AND different paint. Unmirrored, he arrives backwards and the wrong colour.

invariants.title: Lights after landing
invariants.rule: The lights come on INSIDE the store - masked to the glazing - and only AFTER he lands.
invariants.why: Grading the whole shopfront reads as an exposure change. Light behind the glass reads as somebody flicking a switch, which is the point.

flair.title: Tumble count
flair.note: two full rotations, easing out into the landing
